release.title: Profound Sounds Vol. 1
release.notes:
Track 1 title is given as "D2" (which is the side of record on the vinyl version of i220-010 release). This was also released on CD where this track is listed on 8th position. On both version no titles are given (only writing/producing credits). You can see both versions of i220-010 at the master release page [m27265]. Track 1 and 12 contains acapella of "Sixth Sense" by Josh Wink featuring Ursula Rucker. Track 4 is credited as "J. Dahlbäck". Have been released later under "The Persuader". Track 5 is wrongly titled as Vol. 1. Track 6 is credited as "Gez Varley presents Tony Montana". Track 8 has the first artist misspelled as "Merio's Dubwork". Track 10 is credited as "Stacey Pullen presents Black Odyssey". Track 12 is exclusive to this release.
Artist and track names are typed in all lower case.
Some copies released with hype sticker K 63628 S1 on jewelcase lid.

release.title: Split #8
release.notes:
Withdrawn on 11 October after [a=Stefan Betke] informed the label that the B-side was neither recorded nor authorized by him. FatCat recalled a bulk of 200 pressed copies from its distributor [l264555] and radio pluggers; only 30 to 40 copies exist.
According to a press statement from 26 October '99, FatCat Records initially suspected [url=https://discogs.com/label/43509]V/Vm[/url] duo pulled the prank, with rumors that [url=https://discogs.com/artist/22466]Andy McGregor[/url] bootlegged Pole's concert in New York, USA. The label also speculated that the B1 track title ("Beast," or "Animal Hijack" in English) referred to Andy's moniker [a7593]. However, Stefan clarified these were just badly manipulated and cheaply sampled older [a=Pole] tracks. Andy and [url=https://www.discogs.com/artist/6823124]Jim[/url] categorically denied involvement and complained that someone had been pulling similar pranks on V/Vm around the time. Despite the label's claims that Pole had produced a legitimate replacement track and 'Split Series #8' would be released "early spring 2000," the resulting [url=https://discogs.com/release/13050]12FAT024-X[/url] 12" featured [a=Pimmon] on the reverse, not [a=Pole].
